messages.body_plain:
Hi ALL,

I need urgent help with a figure I am trying to create. 
I want to create a plot so that the background will be an image of a map 
(already drawn using RGoogleMaps) and then plot point locations on it. 
I would like to do this using the iplot function in the iPlots package to enable 
me obtain an interactive environment further analysis.

Any form of help or suggestions will will be highly appreciated.

Thanks.
